reproduce_first.note: This was a feature request, not a bug fix.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask specifically requested showing how many todos are completed.

stack_discovery.note: The agent read the package scripts, README, and Playwright configuration before running checks.

incremental_slices.note: The agent added the count and test, checked the layout, adjusted it in response to what it saw, and reran checks.

self_review.note: The agent reviewed screenshots and adjusted the layout after spotting a possible overlap.

simplification_pass.note: The later layout changes addressed a visual issue; no behavior-preserving cleanup after passing checks is shown.

test_experiment.note: The agent added and ran an end-to-end test but did not show that it fails when the change is broken.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The steps do not indicate that existing documentation became stale.

scope_kept.note: The agent listed the unrelated ID bug as existing and left it untouched.

verification_story.note: The done summary lists the checks and their results, along with the browser layout check.

hand_check.note: The agent checked the footer in a running app, reviewed screenshots, and reported testing with 150 todos.
